characters.description: The last gunslinger of Gilead, driven toward the Dark Tower and now forced to split his ka-tet to chase two urgent tasks at once. Determined and unshakable, he leads part of the company back into twentieth-century America to protect the forces that keep the Tower standing.
characters.name: Roland Deschain

characters.description: A young man from New York, drawn into Mid-World and now a full gunslinger of the ka-tet, married to Susannah. He goes with Roland into their old world to secure the vacant lot and the rose that anchor the Tower.
characters.name: Eddie Dean

characters.description: A woman from 1960s New York, drawn into Mid-World and long since made whole, a gunslinger married to Eddie. As this book begins she is no longer fully in command of her own body: a second personality has taken hold to carry the child she is pregnant with, and she is being driven toward a birth she never chose.
characters.name: Susannah Dean

characters.description: A boy from New York, drawn into Mid-World and now a full gunslinger of the ka-tet, bonded to the billy-bumbler Oy. He crosses into the city to try to find and protect Susannah before she can be harmed.
characters.name: Jake Chambers

characters.description: A billy-bumbler, a small, clever animal of Mid-World that can echo human speech, devoted to Jake and to the whole company.
characters.name: Oy

characters.description: A former priest from another world's America, now traveling with the ka-tet after the events in Calla Bryn Sturgis. Haunted by his past but resolute, he follows Susannah's trail with Jake to try to save her.
characters.name: Father Callahan

characters.description: A being who has taken hold within Susannah's body and largely displaced her, single-minded in her determination to give birth to the child she calls her own. Longing above all else to be a mother, she has struck a bargain with dark powers and will let nothing stop her from reaching the place where the child is to be born.
characters.name: Mia

characters.description: A writer living in Maine in the late 1970s whom Roland and Eddie seek out in their old world. To their astonishment he appears to be the author through whom the tale of their quest is being told, which makes his survival and continued work strangely bound up with the fate of the Tower.
characters.name: Stephen King
